summary: Split 1a: route every draw through a renderer current target
author: pm
body:
Replace each hard-wired `m_backBuffer` draw (primitives, `SFMLSprite::DrawInternal`, `DrawWidth`, `DrawShifted`, TTF text, bitmap glyphs) with one current target; clip and scissor per target.

**Done when:** grep finds no direct back-buffer draw outside the world target code; Debug build 0 errors; reviewed.

Source: user request 2026-11-23; plan .claude/design/plans/world-screen-split.md.
